Generation II is [[hub:Martial]] or [[hub:TimeTravel]]. The Fates chose it at random (50/50) when the game began, and nothing you do changes it. Some of the rumors at the Town Hall hint at which one it will be.
Now: your village name decides it: {{0=?|[[hub:TimeTravel]]|[[hub:Martial]]}}.

Generation III follows whoever wins the war: the Unified Monarchists → [[hub:MonarchReign]], the Separatists → [[hub:Peace]]. The town holds with the {{0=?|Unified Monarchists|Separatists}}, and the {{1=?|Unified Monarchists|Separatists}} resist. At the end of this Generation one of three tests is drawn at random (1 in 3 each):
  • Sabotage: 1 or 2 buildings destroyed (drawn at random) → the {{1=?|Unified Monarchists|Separatists}} win.
  • Flags: the faction with the most face-up Flag tokens wins (a tie goes to the {{0=?|Unified Monarchists|Separatists}}).
  • Weapons: enough completed Advanced Weaponry Experiments (the number is drawn) → the {{1=?|Unified Monarchists|Separatists}} win.
Now: buildings destroyed: {{2=0}}.
Flipping your Flag token counts if the Fates test the Flags. The Unified Monarchists winning the war → [[hub:MonarchReign]], the Separatists → [[hub:Peace]].

The {{1=?|Unified Monarchists|Separatists}} winning → {{1=?|[[hub:MonarchReign]]|[[hub:Peace]]}}. The {{0=?|Unified Monarchists|Separatists}} holding the town → {{0=?|[[hub:MonarchReign]]|[[hub:Peace]]}}.
The Unified Monarchists → [[hub:MonarchReign]]. The Separatists → [[hub:Peace]].

The {{1=?|Unified Monarchists|Separatists}} successful → {{1=?|[[hub:MonarchReign]]|[[hub:Peace]]}}. The {{0=?|Unified Monarchists|Separatists}} defending the town → {{0=?|[[hub:MonarchReign]]|[[hub:Peace]]}}.

Generation III is [[hub:Paradox]] or [[hub:Warning]]. At the end of this Generation the Fates use one of two tests, 50/50:
  • Paradox tokens left on all players' Experiments: at least a number drawn from {{0=1}} to {{1=3}} → [[hub:Warning]] (the timeline is altered), fewer → [[hub:Paradox]].
  • The Time Machine: all three repairs completed → [[hub:Paradox]], otherwise [[hub:Warning]].
Now: the Time Machine {{0=?|is repaired|is not repaired yet}}.
A repaired Time Machine leads to [[hub:Paradox]] if the Fates test the Time Machine at the end of this Generation (50/50 with the Paradox tokens).
Enough tokens → [[hub:Warning]]. Fewer → [[hub:Paradox]].
Repaired → [[hub:Paradox]]. Not repaired → [[hub:Warning]].

This branch ends in [[end:7]] or [[end:8]]. [[end:7]] needs both:
  • accepting the new meat in the famine vote (end of the Early Years)
  • releasing the gas (end of the Middle Years)
Anything else → [[end:8]].

Release the gas → [[end:7]] if the new meat was accepted. Do not → [[end:8]].
